THE CEYLON ELECTRICITY BOARD ACT, No. 17 OF 1969
Order under Section 57

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 57 of the Ceylon Electricity Board Act, No. 17 of 1969, I, RaviKarunanayake, Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, do by this Order approve the proposed acquisitionof the lands required by the Ceylon Electricity Board and described in the Schedule hereto :
RAVI KARUNANAYAKE,Minister of Power, Energy &Business Development.
27th June, 2019.
SCHEDULE
